policy: Criteria record their declaration scope. Initial molecular comparison criteria were declared before inspecting their runs. The diamond k4 extension is declared prospectively after inspecting the initial k2/k3 diagnostics. Method assessment is not an implementation pass/fail test.

water_eomccsd.reason: Published table resolution is 0.01 eV; do not apply the 1e-4 eV same-engine threshold to rounded literature values. States must be assigned before comparison.
required_conditions: converged CCSD and all requested roots

formaldehyde_tddft.reference: Loos et al. 2018, Table 4, exFCI/aug-cc-pVTZ frozen-core TBE
formaldehyde_tddft.reason: PBE0-TDDFT and exFCI are different methods. Report signed and absolute deviations; do not declare code failure or universal accuracy from this comparison.

water_dimer.quantity: E_dimer - E_fragmentA - E_fragmentB at frozen dimer coordinates
water_dimer.reason: CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVDZ without counterpoise retains basis incompleteness and BSSE. S22B is a high-level reference; report deviation without treating differing definitions as an exact reproduction. No ZPE or thermal correction.

diamond.reason: The Gaussian/GTH and plane-wave/SG15 calculations use different basis and pseudopotential representations. Report deviations without an exact-reproduction pass/fail.

successive_gap_diagnostic.prior_observations: The k2/FFT27 and k3/FFT27 gaps were already inspected; their approximately 0.145 eV change motivated this additional calculation.
successive_gap_diagnostic.interpretation: An absolute successive sampled KS gap change at or below 0.025 eV meets this one refinement diagnostic only. It does not establish convergence of the basis, pseudopotential, band-path sampling, total energy, or all future k meshes; it is not a literature pass/fail threshold.
successive_gap_diagnostic.threshold_rationale: Use the published diamond benchmark gap-refinement scale of 0.025 eV as a declared diagnostic for this additional uniform k-mesh step; retain all other conditions.
